description: Schema for representing medical information for a patient

Date of Birth.description: The date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format

Sex.description: The sex of patient represented as F or M

Primary Insurance Name.description: The name of the primary insurance of the patient

Primary Insurance Type.description: The type of the primary insurance of the patient

Primary Insurance Member ID.description: The member ID number of the primary insurance of the patient

Primary Insurance Group ID.description: The group ID number of the primary insurance of the patient

Secondary Insurance Name.description: The name of the secondary insurance of the patient

Secondary Insurance Type.description: The type of the secondary insurance of the patient

Secondary Insurance Member ID.description: The member ID number of the secondary insurance of the patient

Secondary Insurance Group ID.description: The group ID number of the secondary insurance of the patient

CPT Codes.description: The one or more CPT Codes of the patient

ICD Codes.description: The one or more ICD Codes of the patient
